description: This PHP source file defines a console command class 'GenerateDoctrineProxiesCommand' for use within the OrangeHRM system. The class generates Doctrine ORM proxy classes during execution, utilizing configuration and entity metadata.

classes.name: GenerateDoctrineProxiesCommand
classes.description: A CLI command class to generate Doctrine ORM proxy classes in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the proxy class generation process, configures Doctrine ORM, retrieves entity metadata, and outputs success message.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Retrieves entity directory paths from plugin configurations to locate entity classes for proxy generation.
